gd.desc.native: RenoDX NR add-on for ReShade, uses the game's DLSS. It is turned on from the ReShade menu (Home key).
gd.desc.nr12: DLSS5 NR 12 add-on (imported) for ReShade: works without native DLSS too, on DirectX 11, 12 and Vulkan. Turn it on from its panel (Home key).
gd.desc.feeder: ReShade add-on with Feeder: for games without DLSS or not on DirectX 12. Experimental. It is turned on from the ReShade menu (Home key).
gd.desc.opti: OptiScaler replaces the game's upscaler and applies DLSS 5 (F5 build). It is adjusted from the OptiScaler menu (Insert key). For DirectX 11/12.
gd.expl.opti: Chosen method: OptiScaler. After installing, enable DLSS in the game's graphics options and open the OptiScaler menu (Insert).
gd.expl.native: Chosen method: ReShade with RenoDX NR. The game already has DLSS: this is the most stable method. After installing, open ReShade (Home) and turn on Neural Rendering.
gd.expl.nr12: Chosen method: ReShade with DLSS5 NR 12 (imported). The game has no native DLSS, but 12 finds depth and motion by itself: no Feeder needed. After installing, open the NR panel (Home).
gd.expl.feeder: Chosen method: ReShade with Feeder, because the game has no DLSS or doesn't use DirectX 12. It is experimental: light ghosting may appear.
gd.tab.reshade: ReShade is the add-on loader. Everything that goes through ReShade is here: DLSS 5 (RenoDX NR or Feeder), HDR, frame generation and shaders.
gd.tab.opti: OptiScaler replaces the game's upscaler. F5 build = DLSS 5 inside OptiScaler (uses the NR model from the DLL tab); Standard build = upscaling only. If you also use ReShade (HDR, add-ons), HDLSS5 has OptiScaler load it: no double hooking.
gd.tab.dll: The NVIDIA DLLs: the DLSS 5 model (nvngx_dlssnr.dll, used by both ReShade and OptiScaler), and the game's DLSS and Streamline. You can update them or go back to the originals. For all games at once use the DLL page on the left.
gd.tab.other: Tools for specific engines: HDR for Unreal, UE4SS, ASI Loader, REFramework.

guide.1.title: How it works
guide.1.body:
HDLSS5 installs components into the game executable's folder. Every operation first shows a preview of the files, saves the originals and verifies the result. If something goes wrong, everything goes back as it was.

Close the game before every change. Installed files don't guarantee that an effect is active: always check in the in-game menu (ReShade: Home, OptiScaler: Insert) and in the logs.
guide.2.title: Choosing the executable and the API
guide.2.body:
The game is linked to an x64 executable. In Unreal games it is the one in «Binaries\Win64». If the app picks the wrong one, use «Executable & API…».

The graphics API is read from the executable's imports. «(probable)» means it was inferred from the game folder. A manual choice does not add support: select the same API in the game's own settings too.
guide.3.title: Neural Rendering · which path
guide.3.body:
With native DLSS (DX12): ReShade → RenoDX NR. For games that already offer DLSS.

Without DLSS · Feeder: for DX11/DX12/Vulkan games without DLSS. Feeder estimates depth and motion (LumeniteFX): trails or effects on the HUD may appear. In game, check Generic Depth and put LUMENITE: Kernel above DLSS 5 Feed; turn off MSAA/SSAA.

OptiScaler F5: OptiScaler proxy with multipass NR; it is configured in the Insert menu.

Use a single NR path per game: the app blocks combinations.
guide.4.title: NR model and GPU
guide.4.body: The 310.9.16.0 model is chosen according to the GPU: RTX 4000 → Compat FP16 variant, RTX 5000 → original. A driver of at least 616.56 is required. The nr-packages folder must be next to HDLSS5.exe or in the 1.x folder set in Settings.
guide.5.title: HDR
guide.5.body:
RenoDX HDR: a game-specific mod, looked up in the RenoDX catalog by exact title. If the mod is on Nexus Mods, download it and use «Import add-on…».

Unreal HDR (Engine.ini): turns on the engine's HDR in Unreal games without an HDR menu. Launch the game once first, so the configuration files exist. With UE4SS and the HDLSS reader the card shows the values active in game.
guide.6.title: Frame generation
guide.6.body: MFG Unlock enables multi-frame generation on RTX 4000 in games with native DLSS Frame Generation. Turn on FG in the game, then choose the multiplier in ReShade › MFG Unlock.
guide.7.title: Shaders and loaders
guide.7.body:
Lilium (HDR analysis and tools) and CAS (sharpening) are downloaded from the author's repository at the current revision and installed in separate folders. If Lilium is installed, CAS is already included: turn on «Lilium CAS» in the ReShade menu.

UE4SS (Unreal), Ultimate ASI Loader and REFramework (Capcom RE Engine games) are mod loaders: install them only when a mod requires them.
guide.8.title: Game DLLs (DLSS and Streamline)
guide.8.body:
The «DLL» page lists, for each game, the NVIDIA DLLs it contains: DLSS Super Resolution, Frame Generation, Ray Reconstruction and Streamline (sl.*.dll), with the installed version and the newest one.

«Update» brings the game to the newest versions, «Update all» does it for every game that is behind. The originals stay saved: «Restore originals» puts them back.

In advanced mode you can pick an exact DLSS and Streamline version (even an older one). Streamline is only updated in the modules the game already uses, with NVIDIA's official SDK.

In online games with anti-cheat it is better not to replace the DLLs.
guide.9.title: Removing and undoing
guide.9.body:
«Remove» puts the files back to their state before the install and only reverts the INI settings changed by the app: your later edits stay.

If a file was modified by another program, the app tells you and offers «Remove anyway»: that file stays as it is and the rest is removed.

«History» lists the game's latest operations and lets you undo them.
guide.10.title: 1.x installs
guide.10.body:
Games modified by HDLSS5 1.x show a dedicated box.

«Adopt» moves the install under 2.0's management without touching the game files: from then on you can update or remove it from here.

«Restore» puts the files back to their previous state using the 1.x backups. The 1.x data folder is never modified.
guide.11.title: Disk space
guide.11.body: Originals are stored only once per content (an identical file is not duplicated). At startup the app keeps the last 10 operations per game and those of the last month, then deletes the backups that are no longer needed. The download cache is limited to 2 GB. You can run the cleanup from Settings.
guide.12.title: Common problems
guide.12.body:
The game won't start or crashes: remove the last installed component (or undo it from History) and verify the files' integrity from the launcher.

The effect doesn't show up: check that the game uses the right API, that ReShade opens with Home and that there aren't two loaders in the folder.

Anti-cheat: the app blocks installation in games with EasyAntiCheat/BattlEye.
